title: Oman's fund backs robot labs: MegaRobo's $200m round
sources: The Next Web; Oman Observer (19 Nov 2026)

slides.label: MegaRobo's new round
slides.note: Oman Investment Authority joined. CMB International is new. Asia Investment Capital, Granite Asia and Sinovation Ventures came back.

slides.title: About a third of it came in this round

slides.label: Customers
slides.note: Mostly drug makers, biotech firms and research labs.

slides.title: The product is the lab
points: An AI plans a test. Robots in the lab run it.
The result picks the next test.
With Tencent Cloud and Twist Bioscience, it will test more than 10,000 AI-designed proteins.

slides.text: Where its Middle East expansion lands.
slides.question: If you work in a lab here, would you send experiments to a robot lab or build your own?
